cameras.description: Wide shot of a small, confined interior (originally the bar); both actors and the counter visible. Reused by name across every 'intimate'-scale location -- each location's own .glb bakes its own object under this same name (tools/placeholder_blueprint.py's SHOT_SCALE_CAMERAS), not a single shared literal camera.
Wide shot for large-scale exterior locations (deep space, asteroid fields) -- a small subject in a big, mostly-empty area, pulled far back with a wide lens. docs/planning/CAMERA-SHOT-SCALE-PLAN.md.
Medium two-shot across the counter, hero and bartender in frame.
Close-up on the hero seated at the counter.
Close-up on the bartender behind the counter.
Medium shot of the bartender from across the counter, waist-up.
Medium shot on the seated hero from behind: the hero's back in the foreground, bartender visible beyond.
